addresses.description: An array of delivery addresses associated with this Company. Each address can have specific delivery fees and store information.

label.description: A friendly label or name for this address (e.g., "Main Office", "Warehouse").

streetName.description: The street name of the address.

streetNumber.description: The street number of the address.

province.description: The province or state of the address.

country.description: The country code of the address (e.g., "IT" for Italy).

deliveryFeeAmount.description: The delivery fee amount for this address, in cents.
